problem: The candidate requires a selectedDesignScantling for every ship with iceStrengtheningStatus false, even when the regulation-required scantling is not less than the classification-society-required scantling. The requirement mandates use of the latter only when the less-than condition holds.
required_change: Make selectedDesignScantling conditional on the regulation-required scantling being less than the classification-society-required scantling, rather than imposing unconditional minCount 1 and maxCount 1 in the not-ice-strengthened branch.
regression_guard: Preserve the conditional equality requirement when the normalized regulation scantling is less than the normalized classification-society scantling.
